subject.title: Feature: Floating agent bubbles (Clawi) for macOS

question: Should the first-party macOS app adopt persistent floating per-agent bubbles, and what agent/session lifecycle should each bubble represent?
rationale: The request introduces a prominent always-on-top desktop interaction model whose lifecycle, routing, accessibility, and persistence semantics cannot be selected safely from source behavior alone.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped native design
options.body: Define the lifecycle and routing contract first, then implement an opt-in native macOS bubble experience with focused visual and multi-agent proof.

options.title: Design a native UI extension seam
options.body: First establish whether a safe, supportable macOS window-extension API can let an external plugin own the optional overlay.

options.title: Decline floating overlays
options.body: Close the request if persistent desktop bubbles do not fit the intended first-party macOS experience.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped native design
recommendation.body: Define the lifecycle and routing contract first, then implement an opt-in native macOS bubble experience with focused visual and multi-agent proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository contribution guide explicitly assigns ownership of the macOS app area to Tyler Yust.
